carried_forward_from_phase_34.pdh_pdl: Prior same-contract RTH 09:30-16:00 high/low from completed 1m bars. Skip weekends/holidays and days with <30 RTH 1m bars.
carried_forward_from_phase_34.sweep_up: first RTH 1m bar with high > PDH
carried_forward_from_phase_34.sweep_down: first RTH 1m bar with low < PDL
carried_forward_from_phase_34.sweep_timestamp: 1m bar open (event known at bar close = open+60s)
carried_forward_from_phase_34.penetration: PDH: bar.high - PDH; PDL: PDL - bar.low
carried_forward_from_phase_34.outcome_path_start: first 1m bar strictly after sweep bar (open+60s)
carried_forward_from_phase_34.unresolved: NEITHER (neither condition) and AMBIGUOUS (same 1m bar hits both)
carried_forward_from_phase_34.download_window: T-60s through T+120s (Phase 34). T+300 not used: 1m labels do not consume MBP after bar close. T-120 not used: would change OFI lookback.
carried_forward_from_phase_34.shallow: NOT a point cutoff. Phase 34 median 26.375 pts is sample-specific and is NOT carried forward as a rule. Phase 35 uses train-only median split, quintiles, and Spearman.
carried_forward_from_phase_34.news: Eligible sample excludes full CPI/NFP publication dates (Phase 34 conservative). Also report how many RTH sweeps a strict T-5m..T+5m 08:30 blackout would remove.
carried_forward_from_phase_34.cost_assumptions_if_entries_later: market/stop after reclaim; 1-tick $5 NQ; no passive fill at sweep extreme. Entries not built in Phase 35 unless gate passes.

roll.method: AITRADE volume-crossover, activate 18:00 America/New_York on decision_date
roll.pdh_pdl_contract: same raw front-month contract as the sweep RTH day
roll.roll_day_rth: still the old contract (activation is 18:00, after RTH)

note: No definition was changed because the larger sample might look worse. Additive MBP keys (top-3/5/10 reversal-aligned imbalance, persistence, withdrawal) do not alter Phase 34 formulas.
